say:1:1620538001:1.text: I really want to help you... but I'm so hungry I can barely think straight...
say:1:1620538001:1.source_cn: 我……很想帮你……可是……我太饿了，饿得意识都模糊了……
say:1:1620538001:1.male: I really want to help you... but I'm so hungry I can barely think straight...
say:1:1620538001:1.female: I really want to help you... but I'm so hungry I can barely think straight...

say:2:1620538002:0.text: The dog lies there weakly. It looks like it hasn't eaten in ages.
say:2:1620538002:0.source_cn: 眼前的狗虚弱地趴在地上，像是很久没有吃过东西了。

say:3:1620538003:0.text: Magic isn't helping... Maybe it needs food first.
say:3:1620538003:0.source_cn: 魔法对它似乎不起作用，也许……该先找些食物给它。
